faq_heading: Nordel condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Nordel. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Nordel, North Delta: 12 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 17%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 4 of 4 North Delta communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the North Delta total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Nordel fell from 15 in June to 12 in September (−20.0%), and 9 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 16.9% of North Delta’s 71 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Nordel?
Nordel also had 56 houses listed and 6 sold in September, against 12 condos and townhomes listed. The Nordel houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: Nordel home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

17 townhomes sold in Nordel with a median price of $825,000 (the middle half sold between $810,000 and $925,000), taking a median of 19 days to sell at 96.8% of the last list price; 12% sold above list. They had a median $551 per square foot, a median year built of 2011 and a median strata fee of $424 a month.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Nordel?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 12 condos and townhomes listed in Nordel. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Nordel a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Nordel had a sales ratio of 17%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Nordel from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 9 condos and townhomes sold in Nordel over those 4 months, out of 35 in all of North Delta.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Nordel sell for?
faq.a: 17 townhomes sold in Nordel between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $825,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Nordel?
faq.a: The median was 19 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.8% of the last list price (12% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
